goal: Update the pinned Guix build environment to newer upstream revisions and toolchains
Keeps release builds current with newer compilers and removes custom package overrides
agreement: Verified by testing clean Guix builds with matching output hashes on x86_64 (0xB10C, willcl-ark)
Unaddressed objection: Guix fails on riscv64 with an unbound variable error (maflcko)
Unaddressed objection: build fails on aarch64 hosts due to missing system headers (janb84, hebasto)
Unaddressed objection: python-elfesteem fails due to a missing setuptools dependency (willcl-ark)

categories.name: build
why: P3 because updating release toolchains is valuable maintenance but deferrable without an impending release
Provides access to newer compilers and CMake while resolving upstream module deprecation warnings
